landing.hero_sub: Quick and easy baby care tracking.
landing.feat_schedule_desc: Learns your baby's patterns. Tells you when to feed, nap, and change — no guessing.
landing.feat_sync_title: Built for Multiples. Works for One.
landing.feat_sync_desc: Log one baby and sync the other in a single tap — or track a singleton with the same calm, at-a-glance dashboard.
landing.feat_growth_desc: WHO percentile charts for weight and height. See how your babies are growing over time.
landing.story_title: Built by a twin parent, for every parent.
landing.story_body: I was frustrated. Every baby logging app I tried was cluttered, slow, or completely missed what it's like to care for more than one child. So I built TwinTracker — first for my twins, then for any parent who wants a fast, secure, at-a-glance view of what their child needs right now. I use it every day.
landing.privacy_promise_intro: Your baby's data is among the most sensitive you'll ever share. Here's our commitment.
landing.privacy_promise_on_device_desc: Schedule intelligence and pattern recognition happen locally on your phone — your data never trains our models.
landing.privacy_promise_no_share_desc: Your information is never sold or shared with third parties.
landing.privacy_promise_your_data_desc: Export your logs or delete your account any time. No lock-in, no hoops.
